stages.behavior: 生成含 4 条样本的 synthetic 数据与确定性的 tiny model activation
进行 SAE 编码和 TopK，再保存真实 feature ID
对一个目标 feature 执行 Ablation 并重算预测输出
计算 before/after 指标、来源与干预差异并形成报告

notes: Trace records candidate stage intent; it is not an independent verdict.
Official comparison is performed by harness.contracts.wp20_verify.
